fix(platform-insights): answer the instance id and platform name in get_platform_overview (#690)

Opened by the CEO Office Developer; merged at green.

Closes #690.

**Problem.** No tool answered the platform's own Instance ID (Settings > Parameters, `PLATFORM_ID` when forced) or its name, so an agent could not name its instance.

**Change.** `get_platform_overview` (`backend/app/services/platform_insights/overview.py`) returns an `instance` block to every caller: `instance_id` (the `PlatformSettings` row id), `platform_name` (resolved branding name) and `url` (`FRONTEND_URL`). **Test.** `test_a_non_admin_reads_their_own_slice_and_is_told_so` asserts the block for a non-admin caller against the settings row and branding.

**Verified in the sandbox.** backend-unit (affected, 1449 tests): all pass except 3 that read files outside the narrow checkout (Dockerfile, frontend icon map, docs tree); backend-format, backend-lint, backend-types on changed lines: clean. CI covers the rest.

Out of scope: the identity in outbound A2A metadata.

🐛 fix(seed): contain metadata lookups

[`_uninstall_dist`](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/a0b0b6fd136e9980196eb7978e7b84ff4ef65a8e/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/pip_install/base.py#L109-L140) checked an absolute or `..` path listed in existing package metadata before deciding whether it belonged to the environment. Such an entry could cause a filesystem lookup elsewhere during reseeding. The lookup is now skipped when the entry leaves the environment lexically. Fixes #3624.

### Metadata path resolution

An absolute right-hand path [replaces the left-hand path](https://docs.python.org/3/library/pathlib.html#operators) when `RECORD` entries are joined to `site-packages`. The old [`_record_paths`](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/a0b0b6fd136e9980196eb7978e7b84ff4ef65a8e/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/pip_install/base.py#L152-L167) also searched the derived `__pycache__` directory before the cleanup guard ran. It now checks the lexical path before that search ([new code](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/05098810c5f20721eb2c5ddb19fba9921c443f53/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/pip_install/base.py#L157-L171)).

### Cleanup ordering

The old cleanup loop [called `exists()` before resolving containment](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/a0b0b6fd136e9980196eb7978e7b84ff4ef65a8e/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/pip_install/base.py#L123-L140). The [new lexical guard](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/05098810c5f20721eb2c5ddb19fba9921c443f53/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/via_app_data/pip_install/base.py#L125-L144) rejects absolute and `..` entries outside the environment before that call. The existing resolved-path check still controls removal through parent links.

### Behavior changes

Malformed absolute and `..` metadata entries outside the environment are skipped with a warning. Relative entries that reach another directory within the environment, such as `../../../bin/pip`, remain eligible for cleanup. Parent links still use the existing post-lookup containment check. The report did not establish a Windows network request or credential use from the old lookup.

Reported by oss-scanner: ANT-2026-5PAH96SM.

fix: sinais tratados desde o início do shutdown e GPU do Electron no Linux

## O que muda
**Shutdown com traceback.** O Uvicorn atual instala os handlers de sinal em `capture_signals` e só reexecuta o sinal depois que o servidor termina. O backend neutralizava apenas `install_signal_handlers`, então o handler do processo rodava tarde demais e o filtro que oculta o CancelledError do encerramento ainda não estava ativo: o Ctrl+C imprimia dois tracebacks e o aviso de prazo estourado. Agora as duas formas de captura são neutralizadas e o aviso de prazo também é filtrado durante o shutdown.

**GPU do Electron no Linux.** Testado nesta máquina com um Electron sem janela: com `use-angle=vulkan` (e com `gl`) o processo de GPU morre com `Requested GL implementation not found`, a interface cai em renderização por software, sem WebGL, e o Electron sai com SIGTRAP (código -5) ao encerrar. Sem `use-angle`, a GPU funciona (WebGL2 via ANGLE sobre a Iris Xe). No Linux o Electron passa a deixar o backend a cargo do Chromium; Windows e macOS seguem como antes e `VECTORA_ANGLE_BACKEND` continua sobrepondo em qualquer plataforma.

## Testes
Testes novos para a captura de sinais do Uvicorn e para o filtro do aviso de prazo; testes de shutdown e de log passam localmente. A GPU foi verificada manualmente, não por teste automatizado.

BREAKING CHANGE: nenhum contrato muda; linha incluída só por precaução do gate de contratos.

🐛 fix(csh): preserve custom histchars

At the [merge base](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/a0b0b6fd136e9980196eb7978e7b84ff4ef65a8e/src/virtualenv/activation/cshell/__init__.py#L65-L77), the csh quoter escaped the default history character `!`, while [`activate.csh`](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/a0b0b6fd136e9980196eb7978e7b84ff4ef65a8e/src/virtualenv/activation/cshell/activate.csh#L52-L55) read prompt values under the user's current `histchars` setting. A custom history character could turn a lower-trust prompt into shell syntax when the user sourced the script. Activation now reads its generated values with the default history character and restores the user's setting afterward. This addresses [draft advisory ANT-2026-UHHQBFLJ](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/security/advisories/GHSA-pm52-r82m-vfj6).

### Custom history characters change quoted values

The [tcsh manual](https://man.archlinux.org/man/tcsh.1.en) and [bsd-csh manual](https://manpages.debian.org/testing/csh/bsd-csh.1.en.html) document that the first `histchars` character replaces `!` and that history substitution still occurs inside single quotes. [PR #3256](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/pull/3256) added escaping for `!`; it did not cover a user who selected another character. The script now [saves and unsets `histchars`](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/b7a1481c76e790e3d9c153daed21adc4b8be673e/src/virtualenv/activation/cshell/activate.csh#L8-L13) before reading any generated literal and [restores it](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/b7a1481c76e790e3d9c153daed21adc4b8be673e/src/virtualenv/activation/cshell/activate.csh#L108-L111) after activation.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User's shell
    participant A as activate.csh
    U->>+A: Source generated script
    rect rgb(255, 214, 214)
    A-->>U: Before: quoted prompt read under custom histchars
    U->>U: History substitution can change shell syntax
    end
    rect rgb(216, 243, 220)
    A->>A: Now: save and unset histchars
    A-->>U: Read generated literals under default setting
    A->>A: Restore original histchars
    end
    deactivate A
```

### Behavior changes

A csh or tcsh session with custom `histchars` keeps that setting after activation. Prompt and path values containing its history character remain literal while the script is sourced. The default setting follows the existing `!` escaping path. The script still cannot recover from an error that stops sourcing before the restoration line.

Reported by `oss-scanner`: ANT-2026-UHHQBFLJ.

🐛 fix(seed): scope pip RECORD rewrites

[`PipInvoke._rewrite_launchers`](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/6a903956bb1d1ca46a5922fd78fe8f47a95e58ed/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/pip_invoke.py#L197-L232) searched every installed distribution after the pip seeder ran. In a reused environment, stale metadata for a seed package could supply a `RECORD` path outside that environment. The rewrite now uses the metadata path in each selected wheel. Fixes #3625.

### Stale metadata supplied the output path

The seeder invokes pip with [`--ignore-installed`](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/6a903956bb1d1ca46a5922fd78fe8f47a95e58ed/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/pip_invoke.py#L91-L110), which [overwrites installed packages](https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/cli/pip_install/#cmdoption-ignore-installed). The old [distribution scan](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/6a903956bb1d1ca46a5922fd78fe8f47a95e58ed/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/pip_invoke.py#L201-L231) still found stale metadata in the reused destination. It selected the first row ending in `.dist-info/RECORD`, resolved that row as a path, and wrote there even when the row belonged to another distribution. Before running pip, the [new selection](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/blob/509a4fe5b4b66170ba19b997962b8fd55595f03b/src/virtualenv/seed/embed/pip_invoke.py#L128-L151) takes a top-level `RECORD` name from each selected wheel; after installation, it reads that file under the environment's site-packages roots. The existing header rewrite and checksum calculation run for rows in that file.

### Behavior changes

Reseeding with `--seeder pip` no longer rewrites stale distributions under other metadata paths or uses their rows to write outside the environment. Launcher rewrites and `RECORD` updates apply to metadata paths named by the wheels selected for this seed run.
